title: Ventoux case definition
description: A case's `case.json`. A case: its case file's fields, milestones, steps, and a `sequence` shorthand (brief, D2). Shape only: keys, types, name patterns and the expression operators. Whether a field read is declared, a role registered, a plan reference known or a step reachable is checked by `ventoux check`, never by this schema. A model's output may be constrained by it (layer 15) and is still a draft: read by the parser, checked by `ventoux check`, reviewed in a pull request; the builder never runs on model output (brief, D58).

ActivityStep.description: One call to an activity from the catalog.
ActivityStep.title: ActivityStep

Add.description: `{"+": [a, b, …]}`: the sum of the arguments.
Add.title: Add

After.description: The moment a timer fires: time passing after another moment, once (brief, D44).
After.title: After

AnsweredTask.description: The moment a run of a task is answered, whatever the outcome: each answer (brief, D39).
AnsweredTask.title: AnsweredTask

Approval.description:
`count` different people with one of `roles` approve running the step, when `when` holds
(brief, D11) (brief, D47).
Approval.title: Approval

ApprovalDisplay.description: What an approver reads: why the approval is asked.
ApprovalDisplay.title: ApprovalDisplay

CaseField.title: CaseField
CaseField.description: A field of the case file: its type, what people read, and a declared untrusted source.

oneOf.description: A number: one type, exact decimal (brief, D20).
oneOf.title: NumberType

oneOf.description: A task's answer: a closed list of names (brief, D9).
oneOf.title: OutcomeType

oneOf.description: The ID of a record kept in another system, typed by that system's name (brief, D16).
oneOf.title: ReferenceType

oneOf.description: A list of records, each with the declared fields; read with `count`, `sum` and `item`.
oneOf.title: ListType

CloseReason.description: A declared reason a person may close the case with, and who may (brief, D10).
CloseReason.title: CloseReason

Count.description: `{"count": {"over": list, "where": condition}}`: how many elements match.
Count.title: Count

CountOver.description: What `count` reads: a list field, and which of its elements to count.
CountOver.title: CountOver

DateType.description: A day on the calendar, with no time and no time zone (brief, D66).
DateType.title: DateType

DeclaredEvent.description: An event from outside the case: who may send it, and what it carries (brief, D41).
DeclaredEvent.title: DeclaredEvent

Display.description: What people read: presentation, outside the plan's behaviour (brief, D5).
Display.title: Display

EventArrived.description: The moment an event from outside arrives: each arrival (brief, D41).
EventArrived.title: EventArrived

Exists.description: `{"exists": "approved_amount"}`: whether the field has a value.
Exists.title: Exists

Ge.description: `{">=": [a, b]}`: a is greater than or equal to b.
Ge.title: Ge

Gt.description: `{">": [a, b]}`: a is greater than b.
Gt.title: Gt

In.description: `{"in": [a, [x, y, …]]}`: a is one of the listed values.
In.title: In

Item.description: `{"item": "amount"}`: a field of the current element, inside `count` and `sum`.
Item.title: Item

Le.description: `{"<=": [a, b]}`: a is less than or equal to b.
Le.title: Le

ListType.description: A list of records, each with the declared fields; read with `count`, `sum` and `item`.
ListType.title: ListType

Lt.description: `{"<": [a, b]}`: a is less than b.
Lt.title: Lt

Milestone.description: A fact the case has reached, such as `paid`: recorded, never undone.
Milestone.title: Milestone

Mul.description: `{"*": [a, b, …]}`: the product of the arguments.
Mul.title: Mul

NumberType.description: A number: one type, exact decimal (brief, D20).
NumberType.title: NumberType

Or.description: `{"or": [a, b, …]}`: at least one argument is true.
Or.title: Or

Outcome.description: One answer a task offers (brief, D9).
Outcome.title: Outcome

OutcomeType.description: A task's answer: a closed list of names (brief, D9).
OutcomeType.title: OutcomeType

PayloadField.title: PayloadField
PayloadField.description: One value an event carries: its type, what people read, and a declared untrusted source.

oneOf.description: A number: one type, exact decimal (brief, D20).
oneOf.title: NumberType

oneOf.description: A task's answer: a closed list of names (brief, D9).
oneOf.title: OutcomeType

oneOf.description: The ID of a record kept in another system, typed by that system's name (brief, D16).
oneOf.title: ReferenceType

oneOf.description: A list of records, each with the declared fields; read with `count`, `sum` and `item`.
oneOf.title: ListType

PlanStep.description:
A plan the deployment supplies, run as one step: its fields given from the case file
(brief, D28). A case references a plan, never defines one.
PlanStep.title: PlanStep

Reached.description: The moment a milestone is reached: once, since it is never undone (brief, D38).
Reached.title: Reached

ReferenceType.description: The ID of a record kept in another system, typed by that system's name (brief, D16).
ReferenceType.title: ReferenceType

Reminder.description: What a reminder nudges: a task left open, after each of some ages (brief, D46).
Reminder.title: Reminder

ReminderRule.description:
A reminder: while a run of a task is open, start a step after each age. It informs, it
never decides: it only starts its step. Expands into one rule per age (brief, D46).
ReminderRule.title: ReminderRule

Rule.description: On a moment, when a condition holds, then act on the case (brief, D38).
Rule.title: Rule

SentBy.description: Who may send an event: one sender, a system or people, never both (brief, D41).
SentBy.title: SentBy

Sla.description: What an sla measures: each run of a step, from its own start (brief, D46).
Sla.title: Sla

SlaRule.description:
An sla: when a run of a step isn't done, rejected or stopped within an age of its start,
act. Expands into one timer set on each run's start, which ends with that run (brief, D44).
SlaRule.title: SlaRule

Started.description: The moment a run of a step starts: each run, a refresh included (brief, D38).
Started.title: Started

String.description: `{"string": [a]}`: a number, boolean or reference as text.
String.title: String

SumOver.description: What `sum` reads: a list field, which of its elements, and the number each one adds.
SumOver.title: SumOver

TaskStep.description: A question to people with one of `roles`, answered with one of its outcomes (brief, D9).
TaskStep.title: TaskStep

Then.description:
What a rule does when it fires: stop steps (brief, D40), set fields (brief, D42), reach
milestones (brief, D38), start steps (brief, D39). Done in that order.
Then.title: Then

Var.description: A declared field of the case file: `{"var": "approved_amount"}`.
Var.title: Var

WaitStep.description:
A step that waits for an event from outside: its run is open until the event's next
arrival, which makes it done. Pending work, unlike a rule listening for it (brief, D10)
(brief, D41).
WaitStep.title: WaitStep

WorkflowStep.description:
An existing Temporal workflow, run as one step: its contract in the catalog, where it runs
bound by the deployment (brief, D6).
WorkflowStep.title: WorkflowStep
